notes: Verified kobuki#257 and its comments. Eligibility agreed at step 6 (library API): the failure depends on Eigen's documented alignment contract for fixed-size vectorizable members held in a heap-allocated object — an assumption between the two units — and it manifests only on 32-bit (8-byte malloc alignment), so it is not a self-contained consumer crash. Class disagreement: representation_convention is defined as component or byte order, handedness, or encoding of a crossing value; a 16-byte-alignment precondition on the address handed to the provider's constructor is none of those — it is an ABI/usage precondition of the library API, i.e. class 'other'. The spec's own notes agree ('no class in the list fits exactly; recorded as other'), contradicting its class field. Elements api:Eigen::Vector4f and api:EIGEN_MAKE_ALIGNED_OPERATOR_NEW agreed. Loudness loud_documented/activate agreed: Eigen's assertion fires while the nodelet manager constructs the plugin during the load service call, a diagnostic naming the cause at activation before any topic traffic. Resolution disagreement: the spec records 'observed', but the evidence is maintainer corot's statement that the macro 'solves the problem' plus jorge's release note on ROS Answers — the source never shows the resolved composition (kobuki_bumper2pc 0.3.8 + a stated Eigen revision) working, the reporter never confirmed, and the spec itself flags the test machine's Eigen revision as unstated. Per the definition (shown working with both units identified by revision) the status is 'recommended'.
